theWhy: We’re firing up every major muscle group in this full-body workout and getting to know some of the foundational movements we’ll be using throughout the program.\u000A\u000AWe’ll be mixing things up with a method called Peripheral Heart Action training—which is just a fancy way of saying we’re alternating between upper and lower body exercises so your muscles get a little break while you're still working. Translation? Less rest time, more efficient movement, and a whole lot of “how is this already over?!” vibes.\u000A\u000AWe’re here to build strength, boost confidence, and move with purpose—not to chase perfection. Hit pause when you need to, modify when it feels right, and trust that showing up as you are is more than enough.\u000A\u000ALet’s get strong.
